{{< irish childcare >}}

These pages show how many young children are in formal childcare, what families pay for it, the time between the end of paid family leave and a guaranteed childcare place, and how family leave in Ireland compares with Northern Ireland and the rest of the EU. Women's and men's time spent on care is covered in the [Gender equality](../gender/work-and-pay.qmd) topic.
